_comment: Pennyroyal Next adaptive MTP widths: pass this file as --speculative-adaptive-config.
Keys are batch-size floors and candidate steps are speculative_num_steps; at topk=1 a
width's draft-token count is steps+1, so C1 may pick W4/W8 (3/7) and C>=2 stays W4.
C1 also holds a width for 40 completed feedback batches after every switch and doubles
that hold on a direction reversal up to 80, so the acceptance EMA cannot ping-pong W4/W8
batch after batch; the EMA keeps learning during the hold. C>=2 is a single candidate, so
the hold never delays it. Entries omitting these keys keep the switch-every-decision policy.
Launch for it: --speculative-num-steps 7 (a candidate wider than the launch width
is refused, not resized under captured graphs) and a BS1 bucket in --cuda-graph-bs-decode
for the W8 state; without BS1 a C1 batch pads up into the C>=2 tier and stays W4.
